mapper.sql: code, name, version, author, parent_code AS parentCode, thumbnail, description, device, status, is_current AS isCurrent, config_json AS configJson, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: insert into fly_theme (code, name, version, author, parent_code, thumbnail, description, device, status, is_current, config_json, create_time) values (#{theme.code}, #{theme.name}, #{theme.version}, #{theme.author}, #{theme.parentCode}, #{theme.thumbnail}, #{theme.description}, #{theme.device}, #{theme.status}, #{theme.isCurrent}, #{theme.configJson}, now()) on duplicate key update name = #{theme.name}, version = #{theme.version}, author = #{theme.author}, parent_code = #{theme.parentCode}, thumbnail = #{theme.thumbnail}, description = #{theme.description}, device = #{theme.device}, status = #{theme.status}, config_json = #{theme.configJson}
mapper.select: select from fly_theme order by code
select from fly_theme where code = #{code} limit 1
mapper.update: update fly_theme set is_current = 0 where is_current = 1
update fly_theme set is_current = 0 where is_current = 1; update fly_theme set is_current = 1 where code = #{code}
